title: How to Choose an AI Chatbot Development Company: A Checklist
description: Choosing an AI chatbot development company? Use this ten-point checklist and vendor question list to test demos, handover, data and support before you sign.
author: Yogansh Banthia

hero.alt: How to choose an AI chatbot development company: a laptop chat beside a checklist

faq_heading: Questions buyers ask before hiring a chatbot company

faqs.q: How much does an AI chatbot development company charge?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the channels, the size of your content, the systems the bot connects to and the support you want after launch. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to build a chatbot?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the channels, the number of integrations and how quickly your team approves the answers and handover rules. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Do we need a technical team to run it?
faqs.a: No. Clara AI monitors, updates and improves the chatbot after launch, so your own team only reviews handovers and approves changes to the answers.

faqs.q: Should we build a chatbot in-house or hire a company?
faqs.a: Building in-house suits businesses with developers who can maintain it for years. For a business with no tech team, a company that also manages the bot after launch is usually the safer route.

faqs.q: Will customers know it is a chatbot?
faqs.a: Yes. We design the chatbot to say it is an automated assistant, and customers can ask for a person at any time.
